svg.text: A near-miss: a third of a unit of clearance survives half-unit rounding, not whole-unit rounding
An earth polygon in EPSG:3978 tile 5/18/12 (source 6/19/13), rounded at 4096
the ring crosses itself at the circle; earcut paints the red wedge along the long edge (1,117 units²)
above a long edge of its own ring.
painted but not in the polygon
